error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the sensor. Check the connection settings and its address on the bus.
error.port_held_elsewhere: This port is already open as {held}. Home Assistant tells apart the paths it is given, so the same device under two names looks like two ports. Use {held} here, or in the existing Modbus entry instead of {link}.
error.port_missing: Serial device {link} is not there. Pick the USB adapter from the list: it appears as /dev/serial/by-id/usb-..., not as a built-in /dev/ttyAMA*.
error.cannot_open_link: Could not open this connection. Check that the port or host exists, is not busy with another program, and that the port settings match. If the same port is also named in a `modbus:` entry in configuration.yaml, remove it there first: a YAML setup holds the port where this check cannot see it.
error.connection_conflict: This sensor is already used with different connection settings. Change those settings on the existing entry instead.

self_check_stuck.title: Presence sensor is stuck in self-check
self_check_stuck.description: Sensor {name} has been reporting a self-check in progress for over a minute. Its measurements stay hidden until it reports that it is running. Power-cycle the sensor; if the code does not change, the device is faulty.
